When she's gone, she comes to you in snippets, replaying in your mind like a fragmented picture show.

Danger has always held a certain allure. That, in large part, is why so many teenagers drive too fast and drink too much and take too many drugs, why it has always been so easy for nations to recruit young men to go to war. It can be argued that youthful derring-do is in fact evolutionarily adaptive, a behavior encoded in our genes. McCandless, in his fashion, merely took risk-taking to its logical extreme.

He shall moldThy spirit and by giving , make it ask.

He was dying when I got to him, sprawled and twisted away from his skis that stuck up out of the snow, his chest half shot away. I took his head in my arms and spoke to him, but he never answered me; only in a way he answered my love for him, crying out through the silent wreck and tumult of his mind as consciousness lapsed, in the unspoken tongue, once, clearly, 'Arek!' Then no more. I held him, crouching there in the snow, while he died. They let me do that. Then they made me get up, and took me off one way and him another, I going to prison and he into the dark.

positive.author: Lailah Gifty Akita

positive.text: Instead of being frustrated by adversity, our mind focuses on the adventure of creativity with our thoughts. What a glorious paradise?
positive.author: Lailah Gifty Akita

positive.text: Circumvent negative influences, circumstances and people.
positive.author: Lailah Gifty Akita

positive.text: ...I don't ever want to feel that way. Feel as if there are no surprises left. The surprises make life worth living. Expecting nothing, accepting it all. Accepting isn't the right word. ACKNOWLEDGING it all. I suppose I'll just try to figure it out as I go or at least try to understand it. Or f***, just think about it. I'll face whatever comes my way...
positive.author: John O'Callaghan

positive.text: The death of dogma is the birth of reality.
positive.author: Immanuel Kant

positive.text: You are capable beyond measure.
positive.author: Lailah Gifty Akita

positive.text: Dwell on positive thoughts!
positive.author: Lailah Gifty Akita

positive.text: The reality is that changes are coming. ... They must come. You must share in bringing them.
positive.author: John Hersey

positive.text: Theres a remarkable amount of strength residing in those who move forward without being able to physically move. Ones that carry the weight of illness or a disability, they battle wars most know nothing about. They are the true warriors of the world, the ones who have every reason to quit but never do.
positive.author: Nikki Rowe

strength.text: Because when you’re really scared to do something … do it right away.
strength.author: Henry V. O'Neil

strength.text: Thank God for the grace to work.
strength.author: Lailah Gifty Akita

strength.text: The glorious presence of God is with us. Let us rise in mighty strength to build the nation.
strength.author: Lailah Gifty Akita

strength.text: Cassia.I know which life is my real one now, no matter what happens. It’s the one with you. For some reason, knowing that even one person knows my story makes things different. Maybe it’s like the poem says. Maybe this is my way of not going gentle.I love you. (Ky Markham).
strength.author: Ally Condie

strength.text: The greatest strength are rooted in love, joy, peace, patient, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self control.
strength.author: Lailah Gifty Akita

strength.text: We think we are so strong but it is only when others try to prey on our weaknesses that we realize how frail we truly are.”-Skyla (from Twiceborn).
strength.author: JP Robinson

strength.text: Luck is for those with nothing else. I wish you strength and courage.
strength.author: Annette Marie

strength.text: We can only reach the highest height, if we encourage each other.
strength.author: Lailah Gifty Akita

strength.text: She was a beautiful savage.
strength.author: R.H. Sin

strength.text: It was a crushing defeat, but it put iron in my backbone and sulphur in my blood. I knew at least what it was to fail. I knew what it was to attempt something big.
strength.author: Henry Miller

strength.text: To be acceptable is for one to ignore his weakness while knowing his strength, to cover the scar even though it's always there, however, to be impossible is for one to see his weakness as, not an adversary, but the cherry on top of his strength, to rearrange the scar so that it compliments his features.
strength.author: Criss Jami

strength.text: In the depth of winter, I finally learned that within me there lay an invincible summer.
strength.author: Albert Camus

strength.text: Man's delight in the Lord is the absolute peak of human triumph. He praises God when full of joy, and when not, he praises God to become full of joy. For to know and to live as though God is worthy of all praise, in all one's circumstances, whether seemingly good or seemingly bad, is the primary definition of joy and the richest triumph for man under God.
strength.author: Criss Jami

strength.text: If an ant carries an object a hundred times its weight, you can carry burdens many times your size.
strength.author: Matshona Dhliwayo

strength.text: Striving to be good is the ultimate struggle of every man. Being bad is easy, but being good requires sincere commitment, discipline and strength. We have to work hard every day just to remain good.
strength.author: Suzy Kassem

strength.text: Instead of being frustrated by adversity, our mind focuses on the adventure of creativity with our thoughts. What a glorious paradise?
strength.author: Lailah Gifty Akita

strength.text: Please hear me, you are not alone on this planet hurtling through space, solitude is an illusion, come let me help you, rise up, walk forward, walk tall, walk straight, let nothing stop you.
strength.author: Danny Scheinmann

strength.text: There is a saying in Tibetan, 'Tragedy should be utilized as a source of strength.'No matter what sort of difficulties, how painful experience is, if we lose our hope, that's our real disaster.
strength.author: Dalai Lama XIV

strength.text: I have a theory about how she might have managed to pull off such a feat. It comes in the form of an equation: Love + Fear = Herculean Strength. It’s how mothers come to fling runaway motorcars from their children.
strength.author: Franny Billingsley

strength.text: A great battle is a terrible thing,' the old knight said, 'but in the midst of blood and carnage, there is sometimes also beauty, beauty that could break your heart.
strength.author: George R.R. Martin

strength.text: People with vision sees opportunity where there is problem. They see money not problem.
strength.author: Patience Johnson

strength.text: Strength is not defined by the load you bear, it’s defined by the amount you can bend before breaking.
strength.author: Blake Mays

strength.text: Recovery itself is a very un-glamorous daily process of being willing to fall down again, to break again, to cry again, to get up and try yet again until ‘success’ manifests as ever-greater sustained healing.
strength.author: Shannon Cutts

strength.text: Sometimes you just have to die a little inside in order to be reborn and rise again as a stronger and wiser version of you..!!
strength.author: Aagam Shah

strength.text: For the weakest has but to try his strength to find it, and then he shall be strong.
strength.author: Robin Hobb

strength.text: Her eyes were clear; she hadn't been crying. She was a cop's wife first, a woman second; she wouldn't give in to tears as long as Wyatt was fighting for his life because she was fighting with him in spirit.
strength.author: Dean Koontz

strength.text: But we are strong, each in our purpose, and we are all more strong together.
strength.author: Bram Stoker

strength.text: The strength of the spirit sustains the soul.
strength.author: Lailah Gifty Akita

strength.text: No struggle, no success! The strongest thunder strikes often bring the heaviest rainfall! The weight of your fulfillment depends on how wide you cast your nets!
strength.author: Israelmore Ayivor

strength.text: Endure despite the pain. The key is grace of strength.
strength.author: Lailah Gifty Akita
